questions.question: Which manager guided Everton to a 4th-place Premier League finish in the 2004–05 season, securing their highest top-flight position since 1988?
questions.explanation: David Moyes guided Everton to 4th place in 2004–05 despite selling Wayne Rooney prior to the season, earning a Champions League qualification spot.

questions.question: True or False: Leicester City were top of the Premier League table on Christmas Day during their famous 2015–16 title-winning season.
questions.explanation: Claudio Ranieri's Leicester City sat top of the Premier League on Christmas Day 2015 with 38 points, exactly twelve months after occupying bottom spot on Christmas Day 2014.
questions.anchorClues: Leicester City Christmas top of table 2015–16

questions.question: Which Midlands club conceded only 34 goals during the 1995–96 season under Brian Little, finishing 4th in the Premier League and lifting the League Cup?
questions.explanation: Aston Villa enjoyed a stellar 1995–96 campaign, defeating Leeds United 3–0 in the League Cup final and securing a top-four Premier League finish.
questions.anchorClues: Brian Little Aston Villa 1995–96 / League Cup

questions.question: Which club produced a memorable upset by defeating champions Manchester City 3–2 at Carrow Road in September 2019, despite missing eight senior players through injury?
questions.explanation: Daniel Farke's newly promoted Norwich City capitalised on defensive errors from Manchester City to claim a famous 3–2 home victory.

questions.question: True or False: Gareth Bale scored a hat-trick on his final Premier League appearance for Tottenham Hotspur before moving to Real Madrid in 2013.
questions.explanation: Gareth Bale scored a single spectacular 89th-minute winning goal against Sunderland on the final day of the 2012–13 season, rather than a hat-trick.

questions.question: What was the final scoreline when Aston Villa famously defeated reigning champions Liverpool at Villa Park in October 2020, inflicting Liverpool's heaviest top-flight defeat in 57 years?
questions.explanation: Ollie Watkins scored a first-half hat-trick as Dean Smith's Aston Villa stunned Jürgen Klopp's champions in a remarkable 7–2 scoreline.

questions.question: Which squad number did Uruguayan striker Luis Suárez wear during his explosive three-and-a-half seasons at Liverpool, where he scored 69 Premier League goals?
questions.explanation: Luis Suárez wore the famous number 7 shirt at Anfield from January 2011 until his summer departure in 2014, winning the PFA Player of the Year in 2013–14.

questions.question: Which Ivory Coast midfielder scored 20 Premier League goals during Manchester City's title-winning 2013–14 season, becoming only the second midfielder to hit 20 goals in a single PL campaign?
questions.explanation: Yaya Touré enjoyed an incredible 2013–14 campaign, scoring 20 goals from midfield under Manuel Pellegrini as City claimed their second Premier League title.

questions.question: Which Italian manager guided Chelsea to the 2016–17 Premier League title in his debut season in English football, setting a then-record 30 wins in a 38-game season?
questions.explanation: Antonio Conte transformed Chelsea's season by switching to a 3–4–3 tactical system, leading the Blues to the title with 93 points.

questions.question: Which Spanish goalkeeper equalled the Premier League record for the most saves in a single match by making 14 saves in a 3–1 victory over Arsenal at the Emirates Stadium in December 2017?
questions.explanation: David de Gea delivered a masterclass in goal for Manchester United, making 14 saves to match the Premier League single-game record set by Tim Krul in 2013.
questions.anchorClues: David de Gea 14 saves vs Arsenal 2017
